name: Relevance to Context
description: Measures how well the response is related to the context provided in the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the ability of the response to keep the conversation engaging and interesting.

name: Clarity and Coherence
description: Assesses the clarity and coherence of the response, ensuring it is easy to understand and logically structured.

name: Use of Interesting Fact
description: Measures the effective use of the interesting fact provided in the context, if applicable.

name: Creativity
description: Evaluates the creativity and originality of the response in the context of the conversation.
